# temps_backup_schedule (Resource)

A recurring backup of managed services (and optionally the Temps control plane) to a backup destination.

Required API key permissions: `backups:create`, `backups:read`, `backups:write`, `backups:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_backup_schedule" "nightly" {
  name                = "nightly"
  description         = "Nightly database backups"
  schedule_expression = "0 0 3 * * *" # seconds-first cron: daily at 03:00
  retention_period    = 7
  s3_source_id        = temps_backup_destination.s3.id
  service_ids         = [temps_service.db.id]
  tags                = ["nightly"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Schedule name.
- `retention_period` (Number) How many days backups are kept.
- `schedule_expression` (String) When to run, as a cron expression **with a leading seconds field**: `0 0 3 * * *` runs daily at 03:00 (server time).

### Optional

- `backup_type` (String) Backup type, `full` by default. Changing it replaces the schedule.
- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the schedule runs.
- `include_control_plane` (Boolean) Also back up the Temps control-plane database.
- `max_runtime_secs` (Number) Abort a run that takes longer than this many seconds.
- `s3_source_id` (Number) ID of the `temps_backup_destination` to write to; the default destination when unset. Changing it replaces the schedule.
- `service_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the services to back up. Conflicts with `target_all_services = true`.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags attached to every backup the schedule takes.
- `target_all_services` (Boolean) Back up every service, including ones created later.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric schedule ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import temps_backup_schedule.nightly 5
```
